name: Food Truck Operations
audience: independent food trucks and small mobile-food fleets
topic: commissary preparation and event-location readiness for food trucks

products.name: Food Truck Prep Board
products.product: A focused food truck commissary preparation tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent food trucks and small mobile-food fleets
products.problem: Menu plans, commissary production, truck stock, equipment, fuel, water, packaging, and staff assignments are checked through separate lists.
products.valueProposition: Turns food truck commissary preparation tracking into a visible operating queue so every truck leaves the commissary with the approved menu, required stock, equipment, and service resources verified.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets food truck commissary preparation tracking software, food truck commissary preparation tracking tracker, food truck commissary preparation tracking template, and food truck commissary preparation tracking checklist searches.

products.name: Food Truck Location Readiness
products.product: A focused food truck event and location readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent food trucks and small mobile-food fleets
products.problem: Permits, organizer contacts, arrival windows, parking, power, menu restrictions, fees, expected demand, and cancellation terms change after booking.
products.valueProposition: Turns food truck event and location readiness into a visible operating queue so every service location has current access, organizer, operating, payment, and contingency details before departure.
